articles.content: If you're building with AI and you hit this: Error: Cannot find module './utils/formatDate' Your code isn't broken. Your AI just lied by omission. The trick is sending the GPU one big buffer, clustering aggressively at low zoo
articles.content: You can render a live planet in the browser at 60 frames per second — even with tens of thousands of points on it — if you treat the map as a WebGL scene with a strict 16.6 ms frame budget, not as a pile of DOM elements. The trick is sending the GPU one big buffer, clustering aggressively at low zoom, and never doing layout work inside the render loop. I learned this building WorldEye , a real-time globe layering 74,229 live public cameras with flights, satellites, weather, earthquakes and fires
